scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @mesaflow/backend && npm run build -w @mesaflow/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -ws
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -ws
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.dev:backend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @mesaflow/backend
scripts.dev:frontend: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @mesaflow/frontend
